class.name: OcgSelectmgrViewcliprange
class.brief_description: Class for handling depth clipping range. It is used to perform checks in case if global (for the whole view) clipping planes are defined inside of SelectMgr_RectangularFrustum class methods.

method.description: Returns the main unclipped range; [-inf, inf] by default.
